arguments.query: SELECT o.order_ts, i.quantity, i.unit_price_cents, p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LIMIT 5
SELECT order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 3
SELECT region_code, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1
SELECT refund_ts, refund_amount_twd, item_id FROM refunds LIMIT 3

WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-C' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025'), g AS (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 AS g FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vo)), r AS (SELECT SUM(refund_amount_twd) AS r FROM refunds WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM vo)) SELECT g.g, r.r, g.g-r.r FROM g, r
